definitions.explanation: A paved path for pedestrians alongside a road.

examples.japanese: {歩道|ほどう}を{歩|ある}いてください。
{歩道|ほどう}に{自転車|じてんしゃ}が{止|と}まっている。
examples.english: A bicycle is parked on the sidewalk.

examples.japanese: {歩道橋|ほどうきょう}を{渡|わた}って{反対側|はんたいがわ}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'll cross using the pedestrian overpass to get to the other side.

notes:
A basic urban vocabulary word.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{歩道橋|ほどうきょう} (pedestrian overpass)
・{横断歩道|おうだんほどう} (crosswalk, pedestrian crossing)
・{自転車歩道|じてんしゃほどう} (bicycle path)

RELATED WORDS:
・{車道|しゃどう} (roadway for vehicles)
・{道路|どうろ} (road)
・{通路|つうろ} (passage, walkway)

NOTE:
In Japan, bicycles are often legally allowed on sidewalks, unlike in many Western countries.
